# Airtravel visualization

 This 3D globe shows the airtravel connections of 4,349 airports in 219 countries and territories around the world. Switch between "Countries / Territories" and "Airports" view in the bottom left corner. Press the play button to see how air travel developed over time. 

 For the best experience, we recommend the Chrome, Firefox or Edge browser on a wide monitor. 

 This project was prepared by a team lead by Andrew Beath with support by Jan Alexander Orlowski and Pedro Soares. Concept and visualization by Dieter Wang.
